sn6.13:1.1: The Buddha taught Ānanda there ([an5.114]()). Once, arriving there from Varanasi, he allowed porridge ([pli-tv-kd6:24.1.1](), cf. [an5.207]()).  At [pli-tv-kd2:12.1.1](), Mahākassapa was swept away in a river while returning from there; the river is identified by the commentary as the Serpentine.
